title: WHEN VERIFIABLE REWARDS SWITCH THE LANGUAGE: CROSS-LINGUAL COLLAPSE IN CHAIN-OF-THOUGHT
reasoning: The paper investigates the technical phenomenon of 'Cross-lingual Collapse' in Large Language Models during reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Its evaluation is centered on mathematical reasoning benchmarks and linguistic fidelity, and it does not contain any component evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
